plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Nateks access device. It reports uptime, temperature, power supply status, optical transceiver DDM temperature, supply voltage, Tx bias current and Tx / Rx optical power, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 4249).
name: Access

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Board or chassis temperature from NATEKS-MIB temperatureSensorValue, normalized from 1/1000 degrees Celsius.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: Local power source availability from NATEKS-MIB powerSourceStatus, normalized so available(1) is healthy and all other values are abnormal.

metrics.name: transceiver_temperature_celsius

dimensions.name: ifIndex
dimensions.description: IF-MIB interface index of the transceiver port

metrics.description: Internally measured temperature of each optical transceiver in degrees Celsius, from NATEKS-MIB sfpDDMTemperature (1.3.6.1.4.1.4249.2.5.9.2.1.2, 1/1000 degree units, divided by 1000). Rows reporting the module as absent are skipped.

metrics.name: transceiver_voltage_volts

dimensions.name: ifIndex
dimensions.description: IF-MIB interface index of the transceiver port

metrics.description: Internally measured supply voltage of each optical transceiver in volts, from sfpDDMSupplyVoltage (1.3.6.1.4.1.4249.2.5.9.2.1.3). Raw values up to 6600 are read as 1/1000 V and larger values as 1/10000 V; 0 is treated as no module and dropped.

metrics.name: transceiver_tx_bias_ma

dimensions.name: ifIndex
dimensions.description: IF-MIB interface index of the transceiver port

metrics.description: Laser bias current of each optical transceiver in mA, from sfpDDMTxBiasCurrent (1.3.6.1.4.1.4249.2.5.9.2.1.4, 1/10 mA units, divided by 10).

metrics.name: transceiver_tx_power_dbm

dimensions.name: ifIndex
dimensions.description: IF-MIB interface index of the transceiver port

metrics.description: Transmit optical power of each optical transceiver in dBm, from sfpDDMTxOutputdBm (1.3.6.1.4.1.4249.2.5.9.2.1.6, 1/10 dBm units, divided by 10).

metrics.name: transceiver_rx_power_dbm

dimensions.name: ifIndex
dimensions.description: IF-MIB interface index of the transceiver port

metrics.description: Received optical power of each optical transceiver in dBm, from sfpDDMRxInputdBm (1.3.6.1.4.1.4249.2.5.9.2.1.8, 1/10 dBm units, divided by 10). -40 dBm is the bottom of the range and usually means no light is received.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
